Text layer (pdftotext -layout, pages split by form feed) of nine stored City Council agendas, for
collector/tests/test_city_agenda_titles.py (note-titles). Fetched 2026-11-22, one GET each, with the collector's
User-Agent: six from the CivicClerk API (robots.txt allows /), 10 s apart; three from the Agenda Center at
www.clarksvilletn.gov (robots.txt allows /AgendaCenter, Crawl-delay 10), 12 s apart. The PDFs are not kept here.

Agenda Center URL: https://www.clarksvilletn.gov/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/<Agenda/_id>
CivicClerk URL: https://clarksvilletn.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=<id>,plainText=false)
The source ids are the committed facts' agenda_source_id of each meeting (sha256 prefix of the stored file).
